name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: A key in the Code voice: a key cell with a 2px floor; KbdGroup joins a chord's keys on seams (nested kbd), with the separator read, not drawn. Used by Command.
whenToUse: Use it to show a key or a key combination in text, in a tooltip or beside a command. It is not a button.

parts.name: Kbd
parts.description: A key, in the Code voice. A small key cell: a 1px keyline with a 2px floor, the key's lip. Used in prose and help text, and by Command, Menu and Tooltip for their shortcuts.

props.name: label
props.description: Words for a symbol key ("Command" for ⌘, "Shift" for ⇧): the glyph shows, the words are read.

parts.name: KbdGroup
parts.description: Keys pressed together (or in order) as cells of one key frame on shared seams (C1), nested <kbd> as HTML specifies for a combination. The separator is read, not drawn: the seam is the join.

props.name: separator
props.description: Read between keys (the seam shows it): "+" for a chord, "then" for a sequence.
